title: 43:19 I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth. The new thing that will spring forth is "a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert." In other words, the new thing appears to be the restoration of the gospel in the last days (in the midst of the wilderness of sin and the desert of apostasy) and the establishment of Zion prior to the Lord's millennial reign.
author: Tina M. Peterson
